startup_diagnostics.scope: Diagnostic extrema only; not a full-state equivalence test.

recorded_shell_scripts.build.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
run_dir=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
source "$run_dir/environment.sh"
cd /home/fillmore/BroomfieldDigital/CheMPAS-A
git rev-parse HEAD > "$run_dir/provenance/chempas_revision"
git status --short > "$run_dir/provenance/source_status_before_build"
conda list -p "$NETCDF" --explicit > "$run_dir/provenance/conda-explicit.txt"
cp "$MUSICA_PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig/musica-fortran.pc" "$PIO/lib/libpio.settings" "$run_dir/provenance/"
gfortran --version > "$run_dir/provenance/gfortran-version.txt"
mpiexec --version > "$run_dir/provenance/mpi-version.txt"
make -j8 gfortran CORE=init_atmosphere PRECISION=double OPENMP=false PIO="$PIO" AUTOCLEAN=true > "$run_dir/build_init.log" 2>&1
cp init_atmosphere_model "$run_dir/bin/"
cp .build_opts.init_atmosphere "$run_dir/provenance/"
make clean CORE=atmosphere > "$run_dir/build_clean.log" 2>&1
make -j8 gfortran CORE=atmosphere PRECISION=double OPENMP=false PIO="$PIO" MUSICA=true AUTOCLEAN=true > "$run_dir/build_atmosphere.log" 2>&1
cp atmosphere_model "$run_dir/bin/"
cp .build_opts.atmosphere "$run_dir/provenance/"
ldd atmosphere_model > "$run_dir/provenance/atmosphere-ldd.txt"
sha256sum "$run_dir"/bin/* > "$run_dir/provenance/executable-sha256.txt"
recorded_shell_scripts.initialize.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
source environment.sh
test ! -e supercell_init.nc
mpiexec -n 8 ./init_atmosphere_model > init_run.out 2>&1
python /home/fillmore/BroomfieldDigital/CheMPAS-A/scripts/init_lnox_o3.py -i supercell_init.nc > initialize_tracers.log 2>&1
sha256sum supercell_init.nc supercell_grid.nc supercell.graph.info.part.8 > provenance/mesh-init-sha256.txt
recorded_shell_scripts.run.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
source environment.sh
test ! -e output.nc
date -u +%FT%TZ > provenance/run-started-utc
set +e
/usr/bin/time -v -o provenance/run-time.txt mpiexec -n 8 ./atmosphere_model > run.out 2>&1
run_status=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$run_status" > provenance/run-exit-status
date -u +%FT%TZ > provenance/run-finished-utc
exit "$run_status"
